name: Metabase
description: Open source business intelligence and analytics platform. Create dashboards and explore data without writing SQL.
summary: Metabase is actively releasing updates across multiple stable branches. The current latest stable release is v0.61.3 (OSS) / v1.61.3 (Enterprise), released June 3, 2025, with a beta for v0.62.0 also published on June 3, 2025. Multiple patch releases are maintained simultaneously across versions 58.x, 59.x, 60.x, and 61.x, indicating a mature release cadence. Full changelogs are available at https://github.com/metabase/metabase/releases but detailed per-release notes were not included in this changelog extract.

answers.What is the current license?: Open Source edition uses AGPL v3; Enterprise edition uses a commercial license
answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple releases across several branches as recently as June 3, 2025
answers.Is there a cloud-hosted version availabl: Yes — Metabase Cloud (managed cloud) is available at metabase.com
answers.Does it support SSO and SAML authenticat: Yes — SSO and SAML are supported in the Enterprise edition
answers.What databases/data sources are supporte: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, SQLite, MongoDB, Presto, Druid, Oracle, SparkSQL, and more via drivers

alternatives.name: Redash
alternatives.review: Open source, query-focused, simpler feature set.

alternatives.name: Apache Superset
alternatives.review: Apache-licensed, rich visualisation library, steeper setup curve.

alternatives.name: Grafana
alternatives.review: Primarily metrics/time-series but increasingly used for general BI.

alternatives.name: Hex
alternatives.review: Close source, enterprise focus, AI Analytics Platform for your whole team

alternatives.name: Tableau
alternatives.review: Offers far more advanced visualizations and enterprise features than Metabase but is significantly more expensive and not open source.

alternatives.name: Lightdash
alternatives.review: Tightly integrates with dbt for a metrics-first approach, which is more structured than Metabase but requires an existing dbt setup.
